lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso, with slightly decreased inter-line distance on the posterior haunch and anterior shoulder regions.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 3rd line from the anterior, splitting into two segments near the ventral boundary. A subtle merge is visible at the dorsal origin of lines 10 and 11.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (most anterior) terminates mid-flank. Line 12 (most posterior) is abbreviated, consisting of a short segment in the upper quadrant of the rump.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of 5-6 white spots localized on the upper lateral hind limb and posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots align horizontally on the mid-lateral thigh, forming a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking on the nasal bridge; white throat patch; white transverse banding on all four limbs located above the fetlock.
